dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are present on the lateral flank with high-contrast white perimeters. The geometry of the prominent central annulus shows a sharp, jagged transition from the dark exterior background to the light perimeter; however, the interior center does not consistently exhibit a lighter gradient than the exterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated on the shoulder and upper-lateral regions. These blobs lack internal gradient transitions and are spatially distributed in tight, asymmetrical groups against the dark base pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: An obtuse scalene triangle is formed by the spatial relationship between the centroids of the primary central 'O' annulus, the secondary 'C' structure located ventrally, and the large high-intensity blob situated on the posterior-lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, dark-colored ungual processes (claws) are clearly visible on the distal margin of the extended fore-flipper.
